title: Israeli Settlers Accelerate West Bank Reshaping Ahead of Elections
detail: Washington Post reports Israeli settlers are accelerating efforts to reshape the West Bank as Israeli elections approach, adding an electoral pressure dimension to ongoing settlement expansion and deepening concerns about the trajectory of Israeli policy in the occupied territory.

title: UK Green Party Votes to Define Zionism as a Form of Racism
detail: The UK Green Party passed a resolution at its annual conference defining Zionism as a form of racism, a significant political development with implications for UK-Israel diplomatic framing and further reflecting the growing divide in Western political parties over the conflict.

media.caption: UK Green Party conference passes resolution defining Zionism as racism
